title: Beef Bourguignon
description: A classic French stew originating from the Burgundy region, slow-cooked in red wine with beef and vegetables.
instructions: Heat the skillet over medium-high heat. Add the olive oil and sear the beef until browned on all sides.
Remove the beef from the skillet and set aside. Add more oil if necessary, then sauté the sliced onions until softened.
Add the red wine to the skillet, scraping up any browned bits. Bring to a boil and cook until reduced by half.
Return the beef to the skillet and add the black pepper, soy sauce, and sliced onions.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and braise for 2-3 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Season with salt to taste. Serve hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
Optional: Stir in the rising to thicken the sauce before serving.
